states.name: OFF
states.description: Blower off; start delay reset; cycle count retained.

states.name: DELAY
states.description: Permissive present; 5-second start delay timing in progress. Blower may turn on in this state when same-scan timer Q is TRUE, then transition to RUN next scan.
entry_actions: BLOWER_RUN = FALSE until StartDelay.Q is TRUE

states.name: RUN
states.description: Blower enabled because demand and safety permissive have remained TRUE for at least 5 seconds.
entry_actions: BLOWER_RUN = TRUE while permit remains TRUE

timer_plan.name: StartDelay
timer_plan.call_location: Stage 3 unconditional top-level call outside CASE/IF
timer_plan.Q_meaning: delayDone; TRUE when the permissive has been continuously enabled for at least 5000 ms
timer_plan.reset_behavior: IN = FALSE causes TON reset: Q = FALSE and ET = 0 ms.
timer_plan.first_scan_behavior: On the first eligible sampled invocation, ET = 0 ms; subsequent dt_ms accumulates.

priorities: Highest priority: emergency-stop semantics. If AERATION_E_STOP_NC is FALSE, force State = OFF, force BLOWER_RUN = FALSE, and reset StartDelay immediately.
Next priority: loss of dissolved-oxygen demand. If DO_LOW is FALSE, force State = OFF, force BLOWER_RUN = FALSE, and reset StartDelay immediately.
Permissive priority: permit = DO_LOW AND AERATION_E_STOP_NC. Any FALSE permit overrides timing, state, and prior delay completion.
State-transition priority: only after safety/reset checks, allow OFF -> DELAY and DELAY -> RUN transitions.
Cycle-count priority: increment AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT once only on the observed FALSE-to-TRUE transition of final post-scan BLOWER_RUN.
Output priority: unified output stage applies BLOWER_RUN and count updates after the timer call, using safety-qualified values.
scan_execution_order: 1. Edge sampling: sample DO_LOW and AERATION_E_STOP_NC once for this scan; latch RunPrev := BLOWER_RUN from the retained pre-scan observed output, initialized FALSE; compute Permit := DO_LOW AND AERATION_E_STOP_NC. No unobserved past input stability is assumed.

2. Safety/reset priority and state transitions: first apply reset priority. If Permit is FALSE, force State := OFF and request StartDelay reset. Otherwise execute state transitions using prior-scan timer Q where needed: OFF -> DELAY when Permit is TRUE; DELAY -> RUN when Permit is TRUE and StartDelay.Q from the prior scan is TRUE; RUN stays RUN while Permit is TRUE.

3. Unconditional top-level timer FB call outside CASE/IF: call StartDelay(IN := (State = DELAY) AND DO_LOW AND AERATION_E_STOP_NC, PT := T#5s) every scan. If IN is FALSE, the TON resets ET to 0 ms and Q to FALSE, including all emergency-stop and DO_LOW-loss cases.

4. Unified output assignments: compute final outputs once. BLOWER_RUN := (DO_LOW AND AERATION_E_STOP_NC) AND ((State = RUN) OR (State = DELAY AND StartDelay.Q)). Then if NOT RunPrev AND BLOWER_RUN, increment AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT by 1; otherwise retain the count. RunPrev is updated only by stage 1 of the next scan from the actual observed BLOWER_RUN.
